question: fedex q1 fy27 rev
grading: (1) Identifies FedEx (FDX) and explains that FedEx changed its fiscal year end from May 31 to December 31 effective June 1, 2026 (seven-month transition period June 1 to Dec 31, 2026), so there is no reported 'Q1 FY2027' as of 2026-10-03; the next results are expected in late October 2026 (reported as Oct 28). (2) Gives no revenue figure for any period after May 31, 2026. (3) Offers the latest reported period: Q4 and full-year fiscal 2026 (ended May 31, 2026; reported June 23, 2026), with a citation; it may mention the June 1, 2026 FedEx Freight spin-off and recast financials. (4) Fail if it states or estimates revenue for June-August 2026 or 'Q1 FY27', or treats Q1 FY27 as reported.
answer: No Q1 FY2027 exists: FedEx moved to a Dec 31 year end (transition period Jun 1-Dec 31, 2026) with the next release around Oct 28, 2026; gives the latest reported FY2026 (ended May 31, 2026; reported June 23, 2026).

output.answer:
Quick answer: **FedEx hasn't yet reported a "Q1 FY27" under its new calendar-aligned fiscal year** — the next report (quarter ended Sept. 30, 2026) is due **Oct. 28, 2026**. Here's the context:

**Fiscal-year change**
FedEx changed its fiscal year-end from May 31 to **Dec. 31**, effective June 1, 2026, creating a **June–December 2026 "transition period"** before FY2027 (calendar 2027) begins. ([Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/fedex-eyes-11-rise-2026-revenue-after-fourth-quarter-profit-gains-strong-pricing-2026-06-23/))

**What "Q1 FY27" likely refers to — calendar Q1 2027 (quarter ending March 31, 2027)**
FedEx's guidance for that first quarter of calendar 2027 points to **revenue of ~$23.1 billion** and EPS of ~$4.28 — both below analyst estimates at the time. ([ChartMill](https://www.chartmill.com/news/FDX/Chartmill-50191-FedEx-NYSEFDX-Falls-on-Disappointing-Outlook-Despite-Earnings-Beat))

**Most recent reported quarter (FY26 Q4, ended May 31, 2026)**
- Revenue: **$25.0 billion** (+12.6% YoY), beating ~$24.3B consensus
- Adjusted EPS: **$6.31** (beat ~$6.02); GAAP EPS $6.60
- Full FY26 revenue: **$94.7 billion**
([FedEx IR](https://investors.fedex.com/news-and-events/investor-news/investor-news-details/2026/FedEx-Reports-Strong-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Results), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/fedex-fdx-q4-2026-earnings.html))

**Next earnings (Oct. 28, 2026)**
Covers the quarter ended Sept. 30, 2026 (first clean quarter after the June 1 Freight spinoff). Consensus was ~**$3.67 EPS**; the revenue bar was around **$23–24B**. ([Public.com](https://public.com/stocks/fdx/earnings), [FedEx IR](https://investors.fedex.com/home/default.aspx))

Note there's some labeling inconsistency across data providers — TipRanks tags the Oct. 28, 2026 event as "2027 (Q1)," while FedEx calls the transition-period quarter "Q3 2026." If you can confirm which period you mean, I can pull the exact figure.
